about: E5 routing set (plan section 8): owner questions, typed or spoken, each with the machines (node ids) whose data answers it. Expectations were written from the meaning of each question and from the ROM documents (farm_layout.md: what each node watches; the machine manuals), before route() was run on any of them; never tuned on route()'s output. The speaking node is incubator-1 (it talks to the owner for all of JARVIS), so 'the incubator' alone means incubator-1 and 'the other incubator' means incubator-2 (decision 0018). Barn air quality, feed, drinking water, the farm water main, weather warnings, windows, vents, shutters and the flood barrier belong to animal-protection; zone temperature and humidity (barn, storage, workspace), fans, cooling, filter, ducts and refrigerant belong to hvac; eggs, cabinets, reservoirs and turning belong to the incubators. A farm-wide question lists all four machines with farm_wide true. category: direct (one machine named), multi (several named), implied (a machine's equipment or quantity named, not the machine), default (the incubator, singular, or no machine), both_incubators, farm_wide, typo (misspelled or unpunctuated), ambiguous (a judgement call, explained in why).
